reason: I already have a LARQ that I'm happy with and it comes with me on the commute every day. I don't see what Claro does better, and I'm not paying $68 today plus a filter subscription to swap out a bottle that isn't broken.
objection: It's an unknown brand shipping 5-8 working days from overseas, with filters I'd be locked into buying from them, and nothing shows me it beats the bottle I already own.
would_change_my_mind: If my current bottle broke and the creator showed a real side-by-side test proving Claro filters better than my LARQ or Brita, with faster US shipping.
